question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I have observed that there is proper natural ____________ even at 6 o'clock on summer mornings.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"light"** means the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. (प्रकाश)

 
 
• **Example:** The room was filled with natural **light **coming through the large windows.
 
 
 
• **"Light"** refers to the brightness from the sun, a lamp, etc., that allows you to see things. (प्रकाश)
 
 
• **Example:** The** light** from the streetlamp cast a soft glow over the park.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:** 'light.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lucent** (प्रकाशमान): Glowing with or giving off light.

 
 
• **Example:** The** lucent** moon shone brightly in the night sky.
 
 
 
• **Sparkle** (चमक): To shine brightly with flashes of light.
 
 
• **Example:** The diamond ring **sparkled **under the light.
 
 
 
• **Gelam** (अज्ञात शब्द): This word does not have a widely recognized meaning in English.
